Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CAU Imphal to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CAU Imphal Professor (Vegetable Science) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CAU Imphal Professor (Vegetable Science) recruitment is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Professor (Vegetable Science) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Professor (Vegetable Science) post in the Central Agricultural University Imphal recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Professor (Vegetable Science) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Vegetable Science with 10 years of experience as a Professor at Pay Level-14 or above to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 68 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Professor (Vegetable Science) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 82,500/- per month for the Professor (Vegetable Science) position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Professor (Vegetable Science) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Professor (Vegetable Science) post will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the CAU Imphal Professor (Vegetable Science) recruitment must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Central Agricultural University Imphal located?
faq.answer: Central Agricultural University Imphal is located in Imphal, Manipur, with the pincode 795004.
